tagline.id: Membangun semua yang dilihat dan disentuh pengguna di browser.
tagline.en: Builds everything users see and touch in the browser.

what.id: Mengubah desain menjadi antarmuka yang cepat, responsif, mudah diakses, dan interaktif. Frontend berjalan di perangkat pengguna: bertanggung jawab atas tampilan, interaksi, status UI, dan pengalaman memuat halaman.
what.en: Turns designs into fast, responsive, accessible, interactive interfaces. Frontend runs on the user's device: it owns looks, interaction, UI state, and page-load experience.

does.id: Menyusun halaman dengan HTML semantik dan CSS (flexbox, grid, responsif).
does.en: Structure pages with semantic HTML and CSS (flexbox, grid, responsive).

does.id: Menulis logika UI dengan JavaScript/TypeScript dan pustaka seperti React, Vue, atau Svelte.
does.en: Write UI logic with JavaScript/TypeScript and libraries like React, Vue, or Svelte.

does.id: Mengambil data dari API, mengelola status (loading, galat, cache), dan menampilkannya.
does.en: Fetch data from APIs, manage state (loading, errors, cache), and display it.

does.id: Mengoptimalkan kinerja: Core Web Vitals (LCP, CLS, INP), pemecahan bundle, lazy loading gambar.
does.en: Optimize performance: Core Web Vitals (LCP, CLS, INP), bundle splitting, lazy-loaded images.

does.id: Menjamin aksesibilitas (WCAG, ARIA, navigasi keyboard) dan dukungan lintas browser/perangkat.
does.en: Ensure accessibility (WCAG, ARIA, keyboard navigation) and cross-browser/device support.

does.id: Menulis tes komponen dan end-to-end (Testing Library, Playwright, Cypress).
does.en: Write component and end-to-end tests (Testing Library, Playwright, Cypress).

day.id: Mengimplementasikan komponen dari desain Figma dan menyesuaikannya untuk layar HP.
day.en: Implement components from Figma designs and adapt them for phones.

day.id: Memperbaiki bug tampilan di browser tertentu atau ukuran layar tertentu.
day.en: Fix visual bugs in a specific browser or screen size.

day.id: Menyambungkan UI ke endpoint API bersama tim backend dan menyepakati kontrak data.
day.en: Wire the UI to API endpoints with the backend team and agree on the data contract.

day.id: Mengukur kinerja dengan Lighthouse lalu memangkas JavaScript yang tidak perlu.
day.en: Measure performance with Lighthouse and trim unneeded JavaScript.

path.id: Dasar web: HTML, CSS, JavaScript murni, dan cara kerja browser/HTTP.
path.en: Web basics: HTML, CSS, plain JavaScript, and how browsers/HTTP work.

path.id: Responsif & aksesibilitas: flexbox, grid, media query, ARIA.
path.en: Responsive & accessibility: flexbox, grid, media queries, ARIA.

path.id: Satu framework mendalam (mis. React) + TypeScript + manajemen state.
path.en: One framework in depth (e.g. React) + TypeScript + state management.

path.id: Kinerja, tes, dan build tool (Vite/Webpack); lalu meta-framework seperti Next.js.
path.en: Performance, testing, and build tools (Vite/Webpack); then a meta-framework like Next.js.

pitfalls.id: Menganggap validasi di browser sudah cukup — pengguna bisa melewatinya; server tetap wajib memvalidasi.
pitfalls.en: Assuming browser validation is enough — users can bypass it; the server must still validate.

pitfalls.id: Menyimpan token sensitif di localStorage sehingga mudah dicuri lewat XSS.
pitfalls.en: Storing sensitive tokens in localStorage, making them easy to steal via XSS.

pitfalls.id: Memuat semua gambar dan skrip di awal sehingga halaman lambat dan CLS memburuk.
pitfalls.en: Loading every image and script up front, making pages slow and CLS worse.

security.id: XSS: escape keluaran, hindari innerHTML/dangerouslySetInnerHTML dengan data pengguna, pakai Content-Security-Policy.
security.en: XSS: escape output, avoid innerHTML/dangerouslySetInnerHTML with user data, use a Content-Security-Policy.

security.id: Jaga dependensi npm tetap aman (npm audit, Dependabot) dan pindai rahasia agar tak ikut ter-bundle.
security.en: Keep npm dependencies safe (npm audit, Dependabot) and scan for secrets so they don't get bundled.

master.id: Master Frontend di Developer Mode menguji: output JavaScript (event loop, closure), CSS cascade/flex/grid, event DOM, hook React, Web Vitals, aksesibilitas, dan responsif/mobile.
master.en: Master Frontend in Developer Mode tests: JavaScript output (event loop, closures), CSS cascade/flex/grid, DOM events, React hooks, Web Vitals, accessibility, and responsive/mobile.

tagline.id: Membangun mesin di balik layar: server, API, basis data, dan logika bisnis.
tagline.en: Builds the engine behind the scenes: servers, APIs, databases, and business logic.

what.id: Merancang dan menjalankan sisi server yang menerima permintaan, menerapkan aturan bisnis, menyimpan data dengan benar, dan menjaganya tetap cepat, andal, serta aman. Pengguna tidak melihatnya, tetapi semua fitur bergantung padanya.
what.en: Designs and runs the server side that receives requests, applies business rules, stores data correctly, and keeps it fast, reliable, and secure. Users never see it, yet every feature depends on it.

does.id: Merancang API (REST/GraphQL/gRPC) dengan status HTTP, validasi, dan versi yang jelas.
does.en: Design APIs (REST/GraphQL/gRPC) with clear HTTP status codes, validation, and versioning.

does.id: Memodelkan basis data (relasional/NoSQL), menulis query efisien, indeks, dan migrasi.
does.en: Model databases (relational/NoSQL), write efficient queries, indexes, and migrations.

does.id: Mengurus autentikasi & otorisasi: sesi, JWT, OAuth 2.0, peran dan izin.
does.en: Handle authentication & authorization: sessions, JWT, OAuth 2.0, roles and permissions.

does.id: Menangani konkurensi dan konsistensi: transaksi, penguncian, idempotensi, antrean pesan.
does.en: Handle concurrency and consistency: transactions, locking, idempotency, message queues.

does.id: Menyiapkan caching, pembatasan laju (rate limiting), log, metrik, dan pemantauan.
does.en: Set up caching, rate limiting, logging, metrics, and monitoring.

does.id: Menulis tes unit/integrasi dan men-deploy lewat CI/CD, container, dan cloud.
does.en: Write unit/integration tests and deploy via CI/CD, containers, and cloud.

day.id: Membuat endpoint baru beserta validasi, otorisasi, dan tesnya.
day.en: Build a new endpoint with validation, authorization, and tests.

day.id: Menganalisis query lambat dengan EXPLAIN lalu menambah indeks yang tepat.
day.en: Analyze a slow query with EXPLAIN and add the right index.

day.id: Menelusuri bug produksi lewat log dan metrik, lalu menulis perbaikan.
day.en: Trace a production bug via logs and metrics, then write the fix.

day.id: Mereview skema/migrasi bersama tim dan merencanakan rilis tanpa downtime.
day.en: Review schema/migrations with the team and plan a zero-downtime release.

path.id: Satu bahasa server dan dasar HTTP: metode, status, header, cookie.
path.en: One server language and HTTP basics: methods, statuses, headers, cookies.

path.id: SQL dan desain basis data: JOIN, indeks, transaksi, normalisasi.
path.en: SQL and database design: JOINs, indexes, transactions, normalization.

path.id: Autentikasi, keamanan API, serta pengujian otomatis.
path.en: Authentication, API security, and automated testing.

path.id: Skalabilitas: caching, antrean, observabilitas, container, dan CI/CD.
path.en: Scalability: caching, queues, observability, containers, and CI/CD.

pitfalls.id: Masalah N+1: satu query daftar diikuti satu query per baris; gunakan JOIN/eager loading.
pitfalls.en: The N+1 problem: one list query followed by one query per row; use JOIN/eager loading.

pitfalls.id: Membangun query dengan menyambung string sehingga rawan SQL injection; pakai query berparameter.
pitfalls.en: Building queries by string concatenation, which invites SQL injection; use parameterized queries.

pitfalls.id: Mengabaikan idempotensi sehingga retry membuat pembayaran/pesanan ganda.
pitfalls.en: Ignoring idempotency so retries create duplicate payments/orders.

security.id: Injeksi (SQL/perintah), otorisasi rusak (IDOR), SSRF, dan konfigurasi server yang salah.
security.en: Injection (SQL/command), broken authorization (IDOR), SSRF, and server misconfiguration.

security.id: Simpan kata sandi dengan bcrypt/argon2id, kelola rahasia di Vault/SOPS, dan batasi laju login.
security.en: Store passwords with bcrypt/argon2id, manage secrets in Vault/SOPS, and rate-limit logins.

master.id: Master Backend di Developer Mode menguji: SQL (JOIN, window, CTE), indeks, isolasi transaksi, jebakan Python, rate limiter, LRU, deadlock, status HTTP, dan keamanan server.
master.en: Master Backend in Developer Mode tests: SQL (JOINs, windows, CTEs), indexes, transaction isolation, Python traps, rate limiters, LRU, deadlocks, HTTP statuses, and server security.

tagline.id: Menguasai dua dunia: dari piksel di layar sampai baris terdalam di server.
tagline.en: Masters both worlds: from pixels on screen to the deepest server line.

what.id: Mampu membangun fitur secara utuh — antarmuka, API, basis data, dan penyebaran — sehingga satu orang atau tim kecil dapat mengirim produk end-to-end. Nilai utamanya ada di sambungan antara klien dan server (CORS, cookie, caching, autentikasi, kontrak data).
what.en: Able to build features end-to-end — interface, API, database, and deployment — so one person or a small team can ship a product. The main value lies in the seam between client and server (CORS, cookies, caching, authentication, data contracts).

does.id: Merancang fitur dari layar hingga tabel basis data dan memastikan keduanya konsisten.
does.en: Design a feature from screen to database table and keep both consistent.

does.id: Memilih strategi render (SSR, SSG, CSR) sesuai kebutuhan SEO, kecepatan, dan personalisasi.
does.en: Pick a rendering strategy (SSR, SSG, CSR) for SEO, speed, and personalization needs.

does.id: Menyambung autentikasi end-to-end: cookie/JWT, CSRF, CORS, dan sesi.
does.en: Wire authentication end-to-end: cookies/JWT, CSRF, CORS, and sessions.

does.id: Mendesain komunikasi: REST/GraphQL, WebSocket/SSE untuk real-time, pagination, dan retry yang aman.
does.en: Design communication: REST/GraphQL, WebSocket/SSE for real-time, pagination, and safe retries.

does.id: Menangani caching di setiap lapis: browser, CDN, aplikasi, basis data.
does.en: Handle caching at every layer: browser, CDN, application, database.

does.id: Menyiapkan deployment, pemantauan, dan pipeline CI/CD.
does.en: Set up deployment, monitoring, and CI/CD pipelines.

day.id: Menambah fitur baru: skema tabel → endpoint → komponen UI → tes end-to-end.
day.en: Add a new feature: table schema → endpoint → UI component → end-to-end test.

day.id: Memecahkan galat CORS atau cookie yang tidak terkirim antara frontend dan API.
day.en: Solve CORS errors or cookies not being sent between frontend and API.

day.id: Mengatur caching halaman dan revalidasi agar cepat tetapi datanya tetap segar.
day.en: Tune page caching and revalidation so it's fast yet fresh.

day.id: Men-deploy dan memantau fitur di produksi serta menangani insiden bersama.
day.en: Deploy and monitor the feature in production and handle incidents together.

path.id: Fondasi frontend (HTML/CSS/JS) dan backend (HTTP, SQL) secara berdampingan.
path.en: Frontend (HTML/CSS/JS) and backend (HTTP, SQL) foundations side by side.

path.id: Satu stack utuh (mis. Next.js + Node + PostgreSQL) sampai bisa merilis aplikasi nyata.
path.en: One complete stack (e.g. Next.js + Node + PostgreSQL) until you can ship a real app.

path.id: Autentikasi, keamanan web, caching, dan pengujian end-to-end.
path.en: Authentication, web security, caching, and end-to-end testing.

path.id: Operasional: container, CI/CD, observabilitas, dan arsitektur yang bisa tumbuh.
path.en: Operations: containers, CI/CD, observability, and architecture that can grow.

pitfalls.id: Kontrak data tidak sinkron: backend mengirim is_active, frontend membaca isActive.
pitfalls.en: Out-of-sync data contracts: backend sends is_active, frontend reads isActive.

pitfalls.id: Mencache halaman berpersonalisasi di CDN sehingga pengguna melihat data orang lain.
pitfalls.en: Caching personalized pages on a CDN so users see someone else's data.

pitfalls.id: Pagination offset yang menggandakan/melewatkan item saat data berubah; pilih cursor.
pitfalls.en: Offset pagination that duplicates/skips items when data changes; prefer cursors.

security.id: Seluruh permukaan serangan: XSS, CSRF, CORS salah konfigurasi, IDOR, injeksi, dan kebocoran rahasia.
security.en: The entire attack surface: XSS, CSRF, misconfigured CORS, IDOR, injection, and secret leaks.

security.id: Pasang pemindaian di CI: SAST, SCA, pemindai rahasia, dan DAST pada staging.
security.en: Add scans in CI: SAST, SCA, secret scanning, and DAST on staging.

master.id: Master Fullstack di Developer Mode menguji sambungan klien-server: CORS, SameSite/cookie, CSP, cache HTTP, pagination, validasi JWT, race di UI, serta soal frontend dan backend campuran.
master.en: Master Fullstack in Developer Mode tests the client-server seam: CORS, SameSite/cookies, CSP, HTTP caching, pagination, JWT validation, UI races, plus mixed frontend and backend questions.

fullstack.en: Both plus the seam between them

backend.id: Python, Java, Go, PHP, C#, Node.js
backend.en: Python, Java, Go, PHP, C#, Node.js

fullstack.id: Waktu rilis fitur dan kualitas keseluruhan
fullstack.en: Feature lead time and overall quality

fullstack.id: Semua, terutama CORS, CSRF, dan kebocoran sesi
fullstack.en: All of them, especially CORS, CSRF, and session leaks

a.id: Mulailah dari dasar web (HTML, CSS, JavaScript) karena hasilnya langsung terlihat dan menjadi fondasi baik frontend maupun full stack. Lalu tambahkan SQL dan HTTP untuk sisi server.
a.en: Start with web basics (HTML, CSS, JavaScript) since results are visible instantly and they underpin both frontend and full stack. Then add SQL and HTTP for the server side.

q.id: Apakah full stack berarti ahli di segalanya?
q.en: Does full stack mean an expert at everything?

a.id: Tidak. Full stack umumnya kuat di satu sisi dan cukup mampu di sisi lain; nilainya ada pada kemampuan menyelesaikan fitur utuh dan menyambungkan kedua sisi dengan benar.
a.en: No. Full stack people are usually strong on one side and capable on the other; the value is shipping whole features and connecting both sides correctly.

q.id: Apa bedanya peran ini di Kode Tebak Developer Mode?
q.en: How do these roles differ in Kode Tebak Developer Mode?

a.id: Tiap peran punya bank 800 soal berbeda dari Easy–Hell. Gelar Master butuh minimal 500 soal dijawab dengan akurasi ≥90% di peran itu.
a.en: Each role has its own 800-question bank, separate from Easy–Hell. A Master title needs at least 500 answered questions with ≥90% accuracy in that role.

q.id: Apakah keamanan tugas satu peran saja?
q.en: Is security one role's job only?

a.id: Bukan. Frontend, backend, dan full stack sama-sama bertanggung jawab; lihat tab Tools Keamanan untuk alat yang bisa dipakai di tiap tahap.
a.en: No. Frontend, backend, and full stack all share it; see the Security Tools tab for tools to use at each stage.
